name: AUTOPILOT Workspace · Founding Spot (refundable)
description_html:
Hold your founding spot in AUTOPILOT Workspace.

Workspace is the software we're building for owner operated service businesses: every new lead answered within a minute, the reply and quote drafted from your prices and rules, quiet quotes followed up, and one inbox you approve from your phone.

Status: in development, not available yet. This is a refundable deposit, not access to software.

Your $49 gets you:

  • $49 credited to your first paid month
  • First access to the beta, in the order founding members joined
  • Founding price of $99 a month, locked for 12 months
  • A say in what gets built first

Refunds: reply to your Gumroad receipt anytime before your first paid month for a full refund. If Workspace isn't open to founding members by February 28, 2027, every deposit is refunded in full.

Apart from an acknowledgment you write and approve yourself, Workspace will never send a message to a customer without your tap.

AUTOPILOT.OI is independent and not affiliated with Anthropic.
